claim.text: Eleven members of the Chundawat family found dead in their Burari residence on 1 July 2018
claim.source: Delhi Police Charge Sheet / The Hindu

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Die-cut silhouette of Sant Nagar multi-story brick residence with central vertical structural fracture
landmarks.midgroundProps: Iron mesh ceiling shadow, faint silhouettes of hanging cords suspended in cold pre-dawn air
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Dense North Delhi brick rooftop silhouette and tangled overhead power lines against dawn sky

viewerSees: The narrow facade of the Burari house fractures as dawn reveals eleven hanging silhouettes inside.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Neighbour Gurcharan Singh holding morning milk pouch on left versus dark locked plywood shutters on right
landmarks.midgroundProps: Unopened morning newspaper on doorstep, padlock hanging untouched
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Narrow Sant Nagar concrete alleyway in deep morning shadow

viewerSees: A worried neighbour stands outside the family grocery store that always opened before dawn.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Trembling silhouette of neighbour holding a flashlight casting a sharp cone beam through hallway
landmarks.midgroundProps: Reflective wooden handrail, unbolted double wooden door swung slightly ajar
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Vaulted hallway ceiling where iron ventilation grill casts square shadow patterns

viewerSees: A lone flashlight beam cuts through the hallway, stopping frozen as ten bodies become visible.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Tactical cartographic contours of North Delhi and the winding Yamuna river channel
landmarks.midgroundProps: Pulsing red beacon target locking onto Sant Nagar, Burari with concentric range circles
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Outer Ring Road arterial vectors and North Delhi district boundary grid

viewerSees: Tactical vector map sweeps across Delhi, locking pulsing red coordinates onto Sant Nagar as sirens converge.

claim.text: The dead included grandmother Narayani Devi (80), her sons, daughters, and two 15-year-old grandsons

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Eleven sequential die-cut silhouettes representing elders, parents, and teenage sons
landmarks.midgroundProps: Tactile cardstock tally counter board rolling smoothly from 1 to 11
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Somber dark felt memorial substrate with faint warm halo silhouettes

viewerSees: A solemn row of eleven family silhouettes illuminates one by one as the tally rolls to eleven.

claim.text: Priyanka's engagement was celebrated with 200 guests just 14 days before the tragedy

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Die-cut silhouette of 33-year-old Priyanka adorned in celebratory dupatta with marigold garland
landmarks.midgroundProps: Decorative celebratory paper bunting, traditional brass thali tray with sweets and flower petals
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Archway bathed in radiant golden sunburst paper rays

viewerSees: Priyanka smiles in festive engagement attire amidst golden sunburst rays just two weeks before the incident.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Macro fracture of cloth blindfolds, medical cotton in ears, and tape over mouths
landmarks.midgroundProps: Hands bound behind backs with wire and nylon rope without ligature struggle marks
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Shadowed iron ceiling mesh frame with hanging fabric swatches

viewerSees: Forensic details reveal white cotton in ears, cloth blindfolds, and taped mouths with zero struggle marks.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Outer brick facade showing 11 PVC protruding pipes: four straight and seven bent downward
landmarks.midgroundProps: Adjacent empty plot overgrowth, speculative directional arrows pointing to open ground
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Exposed red terracotta brickwork and mortar joints of the rear wall

viewerSees: Eleven plastic pipes jut outward from the exterior wall, igniting viral panic and occult speculation.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Feverish live broadcast news banner card with pulsing red breaking news badge
landmarks.midgroundProps: Microphone cluster silhouettes, flashing paparazzi strobe lights, rolling headline tickers
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Tactical television studio scan-line texture with live audio waveform

viewerSees: Television channels erupt with sensational theories of black magic, tantra, and ritual murder.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Carved wooden mandir shrine shelf holding a stack of eleven blue-lined diary notebooks
landmarks.midgroundProps: Single glowing brass diya lamp with curling incense smoke and framed garlanded portrait
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Intricate carved sandalwood pillars and sacred brass bells

viewerSees: Detectives enter the prayer room and discover eleven handwritten diaries kept over eleven years.

claim.text: The death of patriarch Bhopal Singh in 2007 plunged his youngest son Lalit into profound grief

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Framed portrait of patriarch Bhopal Singh with white cotton cloth and fresh marigold garland
landmarks.midgroundProps: Memorial candle glow, fading chronological timeline markers spanning 2007 to 2018
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Weathered family album cardstock border with solemn vignette shading

viewerSees: The patriarch Bhopal Singh passes away in 2007, unmooring the family structure.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Silhouetted profile of youngest son Lalit with mouth silenced by a vertical soundwave barrier
landmarks.midgroundProps: Plywood shop counter, medical prescription pad silhouettes
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Dark bedroom window looking out into the silent midnight lane

viewerSees: Following a violent plywood assault, Lalit lost his voice for years, withdrawing into silence.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Fracturing silhouette of Lalit as a glowing ethereal spirit contour of his deceased father aligns over him
landmarks.midgroundProps: Incense smoke swirling in sacred geometry patterns, ritual bells vibrating
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Sant Nagar room walls radiating volumetric amber energy rays

viewerSees: Lalit suddenly regains his voice, claiming his deceased father has possessed him to lead the family.

claim.text: Forensic handwriting analysis confirmed Priyanka and others wrote down Lalit's dictated trances

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Ruled lined notebook page displaying neat handwritten script with fountain pen nib in motion
landmarks.midgroundProps: Magnifying loupe revealing disciplined handwriting without hesitation or erasure
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Blueprint quadrille paper grid with diary dates spanning 2007 to 2018

viewerSees: Priyanka writes every dictated command into notebooks—revealing educated compliance.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Silhouette of expanding family grocery and plywood shops with bright storefront shutters
landmarks.midgroundProps: Brass coins and currency bundles stacking neatly on wooden ledger desks
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Golden dawn sunburst rays radiating across Sant Nagar bazaar horizon

viewerSees: Business boomed and family harmony flourished, convincing everyone the spirit was real.

claim.text: The diaries detailed 'Badh Tapasya' (Banyan Tree worship) where members would imitate hanging aerial roots

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Die-cut silhouette of Lalit holding a ritual copper lota vessel before the home mandir
landmarks.midgroundProps: Sacred thread (moli) bundles, camphor fire flame, rolled dupattas on wooden table
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Dark wooden wall panel with faint mystical tree motif etched into timber grain

viewerSees: Lalit announces the final ritual: Badh Tapasya—imitating the sacred roots of a banyan tree.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Massive twisted trunk and branches of a sacred banyan tree with thick aerial roots cascading down
landmarks.midgroundProps: Interconnected root pillars creating an organic circular temple cage
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Ancient temple courtyard masonry silhouetted against twilight sky

viewerSees: The sacred banyan tree spreads its hanging aerial roots—the tragic anatomical model for the ritual.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Split comparison: natural banyan tree roots on left versus colorful dupattas looped from ceiling grill on right
landmarks.midgroundProps: Square grid shadows cast by the ceiling ventilation rebar mesh
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Cold concrete ceiling beams in oppressive vertical perspective

viewerSees: A horrifying split matches the banyan tree roots directly to ten scarves hanging from the ceiling mesh.

claim.text: The final diary entry assured: 'The earth will shake, the sky will part, and I will appear to untie everyone'

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Weathered diary page with chilling final lines penned in clean blue ink
landmarks.midgroundProps: Fading brass oil lamp reflection, ritual cotton threads bordering the page
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Dark wooden shrine table with soft circular vignette shadows

viewerSees: The diary reveals their fatal certainty: the father's spirit would physically arrive to untie them.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Eleven stools in transit alignment moving into position beneath ceiling coordinates
landmarks.midgroundProps: Orthogonal floor grid lines with numbered position markers from 1 to 11
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Interior living room walls bathed in eerie moonlight filtered through grilled transoms

viewerSees: Eleven plastic and wooden stools are methodically lined up directly beneath the iron ceiling rebar.

claim.text: Eighty-year-old grandmother Narayani Devi was found strangled in her bed, unable to stand on a stool

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Solitary silhouette of elderly grandmother Narayani Devi resting on traditional wooden charpai cot
landmarks.midgroundProps: Folded cotton quilt, walking stick resting against wall, single brass water tumbler
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Adjoining ground-floor bedroom door framed by soft blue moonlight

viewerSees: In the quiet adjacent bedroom, 80-year-old grandmother Narayani Devi lies on her cot.

claim.text: Tommy, the family's Indian pariah dog, was found chained on the rooftop terrace barking continuously with high fever

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Silhouette of Indian pariah dog Tommy straining at iron chain, barking into the midnight sky
landmarks.midgroundProps: Heavy iron chain taut against terrace railing, overturned metal water bowl
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Silhouetted rooftop water tank, dish antenna, and hazy Delhi urban skyline

viewerSees: Chained to the rooftop railing, Tommy the dog barks frantically into the empty Delhi night.

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Silhouetted stools tumbling onto their sides on the floor in complete silence
landmarks.midgroundProps: Suspended shadows holding still in the darkness, settling dust particles
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Cold unyielding iron ceiling grid showing zero deformation or supernatural opening

viewerSees: The stools topple in silence—the sky does not part, no spirit appears, and darkness falls.

claim.text: Medical experts concluded the deaths were caused by 'shared psychosis' (folie à plusieurs) without suicidal intent
claim.source: Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) / AIIMS Delhi

landmarks.foregroundSubject: Official CBI psychiatric autopsy report dossier stamped with 'SHARED PSYCHOTIC DISORDER'
landmarks.midgroundProps: Diagnostic clinical DSM criteria text vectors and forensic laboratory authentication seals
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Quadrille medical graph grid with official Delhi Police crest

viewerSees: The medical verdict: Shared Psychosis (Folie à plusieurs)—they never intended to die.

landmarks.midgroundProps: Gentle cardstock memorial counter board resting at eleven
landmarks.backgroundArchitecture: Warm mahogany memorial plinth with etched names and ages

viewerSees: Eleven glowing oil lamps burn quietly in memorial tribute as the counter rests at eleven.
